answer: A sybil attacker cannot mint identities as freely as a lotus pond fills with pads: to harbor any voting seat in an agent economy, each agent must bond real collateral up front. Running a thousand fakes means a thousand separate bonds locked away, and any detected collusion triggers slashing that lands like a gale, burning that stake. Every extra identity then costs more than it can ever earn back, so faking many is economically pointless.
